header.title: AFT BLOCK B: DANFOSS PVG 32/16 - 3 FUNCTIONS; title block: HYDRAULIC SYSTEM / DIAGRAM

extraction.notes: Three repeated vertical function sections are visible. The left block-level inlet/end section includes pressure-control/relief, gauge/test, and auxiliary cartridge symbols; most small cartridge/part numbers are illegible. A setting marked '300' is visible, but its units and exact component association are not safely readable. Small numbers along interconnecting lines and several component numbers within the slices require a higher-resolution read. Header wording says '3 FUNCTIONS'. S.T. UP/DOWN legend supplied as 'T >5V=B UP=A / DOWN=B', but the exact punctuation/logic around 'T >5V=B' should be verified at higher resolution. S.T. LOCK neutral text appears truncated as 'closed neutral positi' in the supplied legend.

flow_scenarios: Neutral: the legend explicitly specifies open neutral position; the centered spool provides an open neutral path through the section toward return, while A/B are not commanded.
Command A / TO STBD (<5 V per sheet legend): P is metered through the main spool to A; the opposite B side is connected through the spool toward T/return.
Command B / TO PORT (>5 V per sheet legend): P is metered through the main spool to B; the opposite A side is connected through the spool toward T/return.

Work-port overpressure: the corresponding 280-marked work-port pressure-control branch opens at its marked threshold into the common lower gallery; this crop does not make the final dump destination sufficiently unambiguous to state tank with certainty.
Load-sense operation: pressure from the active work-port sensing branch is selected through the lower LS elements and passed to the LS rails; each sensing branch has a 230-marked limiting element.

LS pressure limiters: 230 each; pressure unit not printed in this crop.
